display_title: Oh, the Boss Is a Lovesick!
mangabaka_title: Oh, the Boss Is a Lovesick!

titles.title: Oh, the Boss Is a Lovesick!

description:
As a child, CEO Oh Ha-na suffered from severe morbidity after hearing from her first love, Ha Yoon-seong, 'No!' due to clumsy expressions. 10 years have passed without being able to do this or that, and now you hear the news that Yoon-seong will see each other face to face! Will President Oh be able to convey this feverish heart to Ha Yoon-seong, who is reunited again?
